# SEO-501: Exclude drafts and removed items from the feed

This page is generated from the canonical JSONL registry record. Edit the JSONL record and run `npm run docs -- --write`; do not edit this file directly.

## Statement

The feed contains only items currently published, and an item withdrawn after publication is dropped from the feed in the same operation that withdraws it.

## Rationale

A feed is fetched repeatedly and copied by whoever fetches it, so an unpublished item that appears once has been distributed before anyone notices it should not have been.

## Applicability

```json
{
  "all": [
    "public_site"
  ],
  "any": [
    "has_feeds"
  ]
}
```

## Implementation

Generate the feed from the published route set rather than from a query over all records with a status filter written separately, so a new status cannot default into the feed.

## Verification

- Level: `SOURCE_AND_RUNTIME`
- Method: Request every item the feed lists without credentials and report any that returns a challenge, a redirect to authentication, or a removed status.
- Evidence: `FEED`, `HTTP_STATUS`, `ROUTE`
- Automated check: none.

## Scope

- Search surfaces: `GOOGLE_NEWS`
- Frameworks: `any`
- Caution: This rests on the feed being a published copy of whatever it lists, which needs no citation. Removing an item from the feed does not retract copies already fetched, so an accidental publication still needs handling as a publication.
